exposure: Nursing model of midwifery and postural and psychological interventions
outcome: Maternal and fetal outcomes (uterine inertia, postpartum hemorrhage, placental abruption, neonatal pulmonary injury, neonatal asphyxia)
Negative emotions (Hamilton Anxiety/Depression-rating Scale, HAMA/HAMD scores)
cohort: The study included 115 primiparas admitted to Quanzhou Maternity and Child Healthcare Hospital between May 2020 and May 2022.
finding: The nursing model of midwifery and postural and psychological interventions increased the natural delivery rate, reduced the duration of each labor stage, improved maternal and fetal outcomes, and mitigated primiparas' negative emotions.
mod_finding: The intervention group exhibited a markedly higher natural delivery rate compared to the control group.
